raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 13  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error by misinterpreting the chronological order of birth years. Despite receiving accurate data that T. V. Chandran was born in 1950 and Julia Crawford Ivers was born in either 1867 or 1869, the Planner concluded that Julia Crawford Ivers was born later. This reflects a fundamental misunderstanding of chronological ordering, where the Planner incorrectly interpreted 1869 or 1867 as later than 1950, thus arriving at an illogical conclusion. This follows the error pattern of failing at a basic logical comparison of numbers in contrasting centuries.
